profile.description: Named profile from the config file

instance.description: Named instance within the profile, for providers with more than one; embedding hosts pass it through

identity-token.description: Identity token verified by the configured identity provider

private-key.description: RSA private key PEM — inline value or @/path/to/key.pem

base-uri.description: DocuSign API base URI (default: https://demo.docusign.net, auto-discovered on first call)
